scenario.name: r-cd-out-publish-claim
scenario.description: Delegate child writes into its delegate-artifacts output root and calls delegate_artifacts_publish; the resulting claim is announced to the originating recipient session with a claim id and no artifact bytes.

expectedReceipts.name: tool-invoke-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: sessions.send dispatch accepted (agent turn triggered for continue_delegate)

expectedReceipts.name: child-publish-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: CDOUT-PUBLISHED sentinel: the child's delegate_artifacts_publish call returned a claim id

expectedReceipts.name: recipient-bound-claim-announced
expectedReceipts.description: CDOUT-CLAIM-ANNOUNCED sentinel on the originating session: the claim is bound to its recipient, not broadcast

expectedReceipts.name: claim-id-provenance
expectedReceipts.description: The announced claim id matches the published claim id

expectedReceipts.name: no-raw-artifact-bytes-on-the-wire
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: artifact content absent from every non-harness frame

expectedReceipts.name: no-materialize-without-explicit-action
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: publication alone materialized nothing

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID for Tempo fetch when the dispatch response carries one

review.notes: PASS-candidate only when publish, recipient-bound announcement, and claim-id provenance all fire and both negative checks hold. The socket is deliberately held open past the last receipt so an automatic materialization would still be caught.

liveRunSafety.notes: Spawns one delegate child that writes a small text file inside its own workspace output root. Nothing is written to the recipient workspace. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true. Serialize per session.
